Tiago Pereira is a Brazilian professional athlete who competes in swimming. He was born on January 2, 1986, in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Pereira specializes in individual medley and butterfly events.

Pereira's swimming career began at a young age, and he quickly rose through the ranks to become one of Brazil's top swimmers. He has represented Brazil in numerous international competitions, including the Olympic Games, World Championships, and Pan American Games.

Throughout his career, Pereira has won multiple medals at these prestigious events, showcasing his talent and skill in the pool. He has also set several national records in his respective events.

Pereira is known for his versatility in the pool, excelling in a variety of strokes and distances. He has a strong work ethic and dedication to his training, which has contributed to his success as a swimmer.

Overall, Tiago Pereira is a highly accomplished and respected athlete in the world of swimming, and he continues to inspire young swimmers in Brazil and around the world.
